title: Finance now settles TD Marketing sales: the card moves only after the payment is matched
text: The Stripe payment sync now runs every 3 minutes instead of every 6 hours. When a payment made through one of Rocco's payment links arrives, Finance matches it to its sale and lead first; only then is the sale marked paid, the lead's card moved, the paid call recorded with its invoice and credit, and the invoice emailed to the lead once. A card can therefore take up to about 3 minutes to move after the client pays.
points: A payment whose amount, lead or link does not agree with the sale is parked in Finance for review and the card does not move.
The receipt email can be in Italian: the person's own language, or Italian for a new person when the lead's ad campaign is named Italian.
Only payments from the last 4 days are settled automatically; older ones stay in Finance for a person to look at.
The Stripe webhook no longer marks a Marketing sale as paid by itself.
